patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed dark sections with product imagery and lighter, content-focused sections, creating visual rhythm and contrast.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are paired with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for categories and calls to action.
A sophisticated dark mode is used for hero and key product sections, contrasted with clean off-white backgrounds for informational and service areas.

The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background with dark text, while the hero content dynamically changes, suggesting a video or image carousel.
Product collections are presented in a responsive grid of full-bleed image cards with subtle text overlays, allowing the product visuals to dominate.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or image carousel system, likely powered by Swiper, to showcase different products or brand narratives dynamically. Text overlays are positioned to ensure readability against varying background content.

A sticky header effect is implemented where the initial transparent navigation bar with light text transitions to a smaller, opaque white bar with dark text upon vertical scroll, providing persistent access while optimizing screen real estate.
Scroll-triggered animations, potentially using GSAP, are employed to reveal content sections with subtle fade-in or slide-up effects as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for categories and calls to action.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners dominate for images and buttons, with minimal subtle rounding on interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and major section breaks, creating a sense of luxury and space, balanced in content grids and tighter in footer links.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its cinematic and immersive visual storytelling, particularly in the hero section, which leverages high-quality video or dynamic imagery to present products with a luxurious and aspirational feel. The seamless integration of dark and light modes, combined with elegant typography, creates a sophisticated brand experience that elevates the product beyond mere functionality.
